attempts.answer:
**Vendor:** **Zoom Communications, Inc.** (formerly **Zoom Video Communications, Inc.**)

**Product & Domain:** Zoom Video Communications / Zoom platform software services provided at **zoom.com**.

**Provider Statement / Citation:** 
* From the official **Zoom Terms of Service** (`zoom.com/terms`): 
  > *"This Agreement is between you and Zoom Communications, Inc. and its affiliates (“Zoom,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) and governs your access to and use of our Services and Software..."*
* Corporate filings and site terms confirm that the operating entity—originally founded as Zoom Communications, Inc. and long operated as Zoom Video Communications, Inc.—formally reverted its corporate name to **Zoom Communications, Inc.**

With a focus on enhancing remote work capabilities, Zoom has become a significant player in the telecommunications and software industry.
